Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling southbound in the left lane on a dry roadway in League City, Texas, when the vehicle drifted
into the oncoming lane and collided head-on with the northbound vehicle operated by Driver 2. Both vehicles
sustained front-end damage consistent with the reported impact, and the damage pattern is in line with the energy
transfer expected from a low-speed head-on collision. Driver 1 stated that the left wrist struck the steering wheel and
that pain and swelling followed immediately, a descriptoin that fits the force of the contact. Driver 2 and two
independent witnesses gave accounts that match the sequence of events, and photographs taken at the scene
support them. Responding officers and witnesses confirmed that Passenger was seated in the front right seat at the
time of the collision. Minor older scratches were noted on the front bumper; these may predate this incident and were
recorded for reference only. Driver 1 is listed as a named insured on the policy covering the vehicle involved.
